crossRefs.note: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not…
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will…
He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for…
Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in Yahweh’s house, before the new court;
Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

translations.web: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
translations.bsb: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
translations.kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
translations.asv: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.
